scenes.title: The crown falls
scenes.speaker: X GOD
caption: The Regent fell.
But his weapon was still awake.
scenes.alt: The defeated Regent's broken crown lies on violet stone while a meteor launcher still glows red.

scenes.title: Earthior wasn't yours
scenes.speaker: X GOD
caption: Earthior wasn't yours to spend.
And you don't get the next world.
scenes.alt: X turns from the fallen crown toward the launch controls, holding his scorched worksheet.
scenes.detail: Reference2 shows ONLY original folded math worksheet prop, NOT pre-transformation brown-haired boy or school background. Medium shot transformed lime-haired X, thoughtful resolute not gloating, turns away from fallen purple/gold crown far left toward upper-right amber/red weapon controls. His hands and face in upper-half; one hand holds his small folded scorched math worksheet with simple triangle/fraction pencil marks, other reaches for large emergency lever. No legible words. Behind controls red launch indicator and distant inert black meteor held in cradle. No sword needed: his choice is to stop the machine and protect others.

scenes.title: No more meteors
scenes.speaker: X GOD
caption: The launch went dark.
This world would get its tomorrow.
scenes.alt: The meteor weapon shuts down, leaving the unlaunched meteor secured in its cradle.
scenes.detail: Exterior wide view SAME launch weapon from reference: huge black meteor tightly secured in gold mechanical cradle between ruined purple arches. The threatening vertical red beam has GONE OUT; power coils now dark gray, formerly red ring now unlit and visibly broken circuit, scattered dying orange sparks. No active colored beam or explosion, no meteor launched. Violet sky begins to lighten gently at horizon, red moons fading. X and Z are small safely side-by-side silhouettes at upper-left viewing platform, recognizable lime hair and pink bow, no fear or strain. Clearly stop machinery rather than destroy a planet or restore Earthior. Peaceful pause, focus on secured inert meteor and dark launch indicator above caption zone.

caption: They took my world.
They don't get the next one.
scenes.alt: At dawn X draws a route to more survivors on the back of his scorched worksheet, with Z-God beside him.
scenes.detail: Quiet hopeful dawn refuge on Dread Planet, violet stone terraces and warm gold sunrise over alien distant spires, NOT restored Earthior or Earth school. Keep paper and his drawing hand near upper center, unmistakably small worksheet not notebook or magical map. Z-God sits close at his side with pink bow/sweater, relaxed warm smile.
